title: N6-methyladenosine marks primary microRNAs for processing

extraction_issues.reason: 正文首页标题为“N6-methyl-adenosine (m6A) marks primary microRNAs for processing”，与登记题名“N6-methyladenosine marks primary microRNAs for processing”存在连字符差异，属OCR/排版差异，不影响身份判断。

extraction_issues.quote: Hyeseung Lee $ ^{} $ , Hani Goodarzi $ ^{} $ , Nils Halberg, and Sohail F. Tavazoie
extraction_issues.reason: 作者名后出现空的LaTeX上标标记“$ ^{} $”，应为OCR抽取残留，不影响理解。

extraction_issues.quote: the m6A modification is enriched within pri-miRNA sequences
extraction_issues.reason: 该句前文“Thus, these results reveal that”与后文衔接正常，但“m6A”在OCR中多处写作“m6A”，此处无实质错误，仅记录格式一致性。

extraction_issues.quote: pri-let-7e was more efficiently processed by the microprocessor to produce pre-let7e relative to its unmethylated counterpart
extraction_issues.reason: “pre-let7e”与全文其他处“pre-let-7e”写法不一致，疑为OCR漏连字符，不影响理解。

extraction_issues.quote: the m6A mark on transcripts at pri-miRNA sequences initiates a global co-transcriptional program
extraction_issues.reason: “co-transcriptional”在OCR中连字符正常，但该词在上下文中无其他异常，仅记录。
希腊字母α以LaTeX形式“$ \alpha $”出现，属OCR公式符号抽取，不影响理解。

extraction_issues.quote: a $ ^{32} $ P-labeled linker was ligated to the RNA on the beads
extraction_issues.reason: 同位素标记32P以LaTeX上标形式出现，属OCR公式符号抽取，不影响理解。

extraction_issues.quote: a-METTL3 (mouse, Novus Biologicals), a-DGCR8 (mouse, Abcam), a-m6A (mouse, Synaptic Systems)
extraction_issues.reason: 抗体名称中的α被OCR识别为“a-”，属常见OCR字符替换，不影响理解。

extraction_issues.quote: N6-methyl-ATP (tri-link) was used in a ratio 4:1 to ATP
extraction_issues.reason: “tri-link”疑为试剂品牌名，OCR保留原文，无实质错误。

extraction_issues.quote: the y-axis represents the $ -\log_{10} $ of the p-value, and the x-axis represents the fold change $ (\log_{2}) $
extraction_issues.reason: 对数符号以LaTeX形式出现，属OCR公式符号抽取，不影响理解。

extraction_issues.quote: in mouse embryonic stem cells in which METTL3 has been targeted using $ \mathrm{CRISPR}^{2 6} $
extraction_issues.reason: CRISPR上标引用以LaTeX形式出现，属OCR公式符号抽取，不影响理解。

extraction_issues.quote: We thank C. Zhao and C. Lai of the Rockefeller Genomics Resource Center
extraction_issues.reason: 致谢部分人名OCR正常，无实质错误，仅记录。

extraction_issues.quote: Figure 1. m6A mark is present in pri-miRNA regions
extraction_issues.reason: 图注标题中“m6A”与正文一致，无实质错误。

extraction_issues.quote: Figure 4. m6A methylation of pri-miRNAs is required for normal processing by DGCR8 a, In vitro pri-miRNA processing reactions.
extraction_issues.reason: 图注标题与子图说明“a,”之间缺少换行或标点，属OCR阅读顺序/格式问题，不影响理解。

ocr_title: N6-methyladenosine marks primary microRNAs for processing
self_check: 已核对摘要、正文关键数值（p=2.15E-15、~70%、56%/29%/12%/3%、p<2.4E-15、4:1比例、3×10^7细胞、400 mJ/cm²、90–140 bp、150–170 bp等）与结论方向一致。公式符号如m6A、N6-methyladenosine、MgCl2、32P、α等按OCR原文保留，未擅自补全或替换。仍不确定处：正文首页标题与登记题名存在连字符差异，但身份一致；部分LaTeX上标/下标为OCR抽取格式，不影响理解。
